arab-league|sa: The Arab League and Saudi Arabia are both green flags with white Arabic script. The Arab League's script sits above a crescent inside a chain and laurel wreath in the centre; Saudi Arabia has a line of script over a horizontal sword and no wreath.
ch|red-cross: Switzerland and the Red Cross use the same cross in reversed colours. Switzerland is a white cross on a square red flag; the Red Cross is a red cross on a white field.
cv|eu: The European Union and Cape Verde both have a ring of gold stars on blue. The EU has twelve stars on plain blue in the centre; Cape Verde has ten stars set towards the hoist over white and red stripes.
oas|un: The UN and the OAS are both blue with a white emblem in the centre. The UN is light blue with a plain white world map in olive branches; the OAS is a deeper blue with a white disc full of colourful member flags.
red-crescent|tr: The Red Crescent and Turkey both show a crescent opening towards the fly. The Red Crescent is a red crescent alone on white; Turkey is a white crescent and star on red.
so|un: The UN and Somalia are both light blue with a white emblem in the centre. Somalia has a single white five-pointed star; the UN has a world map framed by olive branches.
